champions.name: Shieldbearer
champions.existing_model_description: Shieldbearer figure: a man-at-arms in mail and a team tabard behind a kite shield, an arming sword in hand. Branch A (Bulwark) grows the shield and the plate, then a castle-crested tower shield and a great helm; branch B (Vanguard) lightens him with a longer blade, plume and cape, then a winged helm and a glowing champion's sword.

proposed_identity_brief.recognition_target: Kite shield and upright armored defender
proposed_identity_brief.color_direction: Steel, linen and individual cloth; shield face as the dominant accent
proposed_identity_brief.motion_direction: Checks shield edge; measured protected march; shield-led contact; shield salute with sword tap

visual_review.observation: Fitted blue chest heraldry and segmented red hem stay distinct; A2 tower shield and B2 helmet/sword progression readable in selected poses.
visual_review.scope: Selected five-form static poses, B2 temporal frame samples and Base match-distance lineup inspected. Not exhaustive continuous collision or every live ability.

champions.name: Archer
champions.existing_model_description: Archer figure: a hooded yeoman archer of the Humans faction with an upright longbow, a quiver on the back, linen tunic, and team tabard. Branch A (Longbow -> Marksman) extends range and accuracy: green ranger hood with feather, yew longbow with horn nocks, then a gilded recurve greatbow, team half-cape, gold trim, and glowing eye glint. Branch B (Volley -> Arrow Rain) fires rapid storms of arrows: dark leather coif, dual quivers on back, composite war-bow, then an armored steel-brow

proposed_identity_brief.recognition_target: Tall bow, ranger hood and narrow upright silhouette
proposed_identity_brief.color_direction: Leaf-green hood, linen and warm timber with readable fletching
proposed_identity_brief.motion_direction: Tests bowstring; light cautious steps; full draw and restrained follow-through; bows with raised bow

visual_review.observation: Green/ochre versus brown/steel branch blocks and bow progression readable; upper bow needs uncropped supplemental inspection.
visual_review.scope: Selected five-form static poses, B2 temporal frame samples and Base match-distance lineup inspected. Not exhaustive continuous collision or every live ability.
